records.c: Rotorua boss sprite source. The file contains thirteen cels with segmented figures, several curved outlines and a solid mask; $4808 feeds this staging area into VIC bank 3 at $F800.
Rotorua initial object array for bit 7 marks an activated record, and bits 0 and 6 can keep it out of the activation scan at $297A. $41BE rebuilds it from the selected round record.
Rotorua initial object array for world X values tested against window edges $2B and $2C at $299A and $299E. $41BE rebuilds it from the selected round record.
Rotorua initial object array for world Y values tested against window edges $2D and $2E at $29A5 and $29A9. $41BE rebuilds it from the selected round record.
Rotorua initial object array for fourth bytes copied into $1C at $29E4 and written back at $2A40. $41BE rebuilds it from the selected round record.
Rotorua round 1 object records. The scan starts at index $26. The following 64 four-byte groups transpose into $9800, $9840, $9880 and $98C0 at $41EE.
Rotorua round 2 object records. The scan starts at index $21. The following 64 four-byte groups transpose into $9800, $9840, $9880 and $98C0 at $41EE.
Rotorua round 3 object records. The scan starts at index $1C. The following 64 four-byte groups transpose into $9800, $9840, $9880 and $98C0 at $41EE.
Rotorua round 4 object records. The scan starts at index $19. The following 64 four-byte groups transpose into $9800, $9840, $9880 and $98C0 at $41EE.
Little-endian pointers to the four Rotorua round object lists. $41D6 selects a pointer with twice the round number.
Rotorua per-glyph attributes. The VIC color comes from the low nibble. Gameplay probes test the high bits at sites such as $0F34 and $0F3B.
Rotorua map rows 0–7, numbered from the map origin. Each row is 128 metatile IDs. The column renderer at $2473 expands IDs through $5600/$5700.
Rotorua map rows 8–15, numbered from the map origin. Each row is 128 metatile IDs. The column renderer at $2473 expands IDs through $5600/$5700.
Rotorua map rows 16–23, numbered from the map origin. Each row is 128 metatile IDs. The column renderer at $2473 expands IDs through $5600/$5700.
Rotorua map rows 24–31, numbered from the map origin. Each row is 128 metatile IDs. The column renderer at $2473 expands IDs through $5600/$5700.
Rotorua definitions for metatiles $00–$3F. Each is a four-column set of four glyphs, indexed as four times the column plus the row at $24C0–$24F7.
Rotorua definitions for metatiles $40–$7F. Each is a four-column set of four glyphs, indexed as four times the column plus the row at $24C0–$24F7.
Rotorua definitions for metatiles $80–$BF. Each is a four-column set of four glyphs, indexed as four times the column plus the row at $24C0–$24F7.
Rotorua definitions for metatiles $C0–$FF. Each is a four-column set of four glyphs, indexed as four times the column plus the row at $24C0–$24F7.
Rotorua disk-loaded initial bytes for the first playfield matrix. The map column renderer writes its displayed rows beginning at $C0F0.
Rotorua disk-loaded initial bytes for the second playfield matrix. The renderer pairs its $C4F0 output with $C0F0 in the first matrix.
Rotorua playfield character graphics at the VIC bank-3 charset base. Each of its 256 screen codes selects eight bytes.
Upper glyph codes include several animation strips separated by flat or blank cells.
